scope: Actual browser-engine.js protocol in a Node VM with a deterministic fake Worker; does not validate browser rendering or CFD.

checks.name: run accepts provided Worker history without replacing it
paused parameter edits do not send run/reset
worker failure terminates worker and stops UI
error reset creates new worker using latest parameters
new ready clears history and error
normal visibility restoration resumes desired run
reset suppresses old frames until ready

observations.name: initially hidden document resumes on first visibility
source-load failure reset preserves actionable error or retries loading
